messages:
alex.sales: FYI — Acme Bank wants a BYO-KMS POC. They asked for HSM attestation artifacts, a 2h rotation dry-run window, pen-test scheduling during the POC, and a clear pricing delta for HSM-proxy egress. Need sec + SRE input so we can give a single response to their legal and infra teams.

cara-sec: Quick Q — are they asking for cloud HSM (CloudHSM-like) or an on-prem appliance option in the POC? That changes what attestation we can share.

alex.sales: Their preference is cloud HSM for the POC, but they want an eventual BYO appliance path. For the POC we will host the key material but they want CMK ownership semantics (customer-managed keys).

sam-soleng: For BYO/CMK modes we have two options: imported key material (customer uploads) or an HSM-wrapped KEK where customer controls the wrapping HSM. Note: imported CMK disables automatic rotation unless we run a managed rotation flow. Example config we usually hand to customers:

```
# POC config snippet
kms_mode: imported  # or wrapped
allow_rotation: false  # imported keys require explicit rotation runs
proxy_mode: enabled
proxy_batch_size: 8
kv_cache_ttl_seconds: 30
```

sam-soleng: Also: if they enable proxy_mode (for BYO HSM calls) expect ~0.8–1.2ms median added latency per call in us-east-1 and additional operational cost for reserved proxy endpoints. I'll ask finance for a concrete delta.

mike-sre: Confirmed — we measured +0.8–1.2ms median in us-east-1 for a simple generate call when proxying to a remote HSM; p50/p95 depends on region and network. Throughput wise the proxy becomes bottleneck if you do many small requests; recommend enabling KV prefix caching + batching during POC.

lara-ops: For the rotation dry-run we need a 3-hour window to validate logs, rollback, and verification steps end-to-end. Proposed slot: Wed 2026-03-25 03:00-06:00 UTC. Also, if the customer wants pen-testing during the POC we need approved tester IPs and an SOW amendment — pen-test traffic hits rate limits otherwise.

alex.sales: They specifically asked whether the attestation PDF (HSM vendor certificate chain) can be shared with their auditors and whether anything is redacted. @cara-sec can we share vendor attestation and FIPS certs to the customer?

cara-sec: We can share vendor attestation artifacts and FIPS/HSM certs. We will redact internal deployment manifests and any internal IPs. For BYO appliance we'll require chain-of-custody docs and an attestation signing key. I'll prepare the artifacts and check with legal on NDA language. ETA: EOD today.

sam-soleng: For the rotation dry-run we'll provide a `--simulate` run and a live rotate run. Example command and expected output we give to customers:

```
# simulate rotation
redwood kms rotate --simulate --cmk acme-cmk-01
# expected (truncated)
SIMULATION: new-key-id=acme-cmk-01-rot-20260325
CHECK: all replicas reachable
LOG: rotation-checksum OK
```

sam-soleng: We'll collect logs at `redwood-logs/poc/acme/rotation/20260325` and provide a packet capture of the KEK handshake if they need it.

alex.sales: Pricing Q from procurement: is the rotation dry-run included in the POC hours or billed separately? Also need the monthly delta for a proxy endpoint in their us-east-1 region.

maria-fin: Rotation dry-run (up to 3h) is included in the standard POC engagement (one-off). Anything requiring bespoke automation or >3h of ops support will be billed at our professional services rate: $250/hr. Proxy endpoint steady-state delta estimate: ~$1,200/month for a single reserved proxy (region dependent). I'll send a formal quote.

mike-sre: Small note — if they insist on frequent rotations (daily), that will increase per-token cost due to cache invalidations. Recommend we add a doc note for performance tradeoffs.

alex.sales: Good call. Action items: Cara -> attestation artifacts (EOD); Mike -> confirm latency p50/p95 for us-east-1 and eu-west-1 and add note about cache invalidation; Sam -> rotation runbook + simulate command output; Maria -> formal POC estimate & line item for proxy monthly delta and PS rates. I'll bundle answers and respond to Acme procurement.

deploy-bot: deploy: created env redwood-poc-acme-2026-03-24 (resources: 2x-gpu-dedicated, proxy-enabled).

alex.sales: :thumbsup: I'll reach out to Acme and propose Tue kickoff and the Wed rotation dry-run slot. Thanks everyone.
